svg.title: T-cell precursor
svg.desc: Round T-cell precursor with a large nucleus, thin blue cytoplasm, and sparse immature surface receptors. Biological basis: T-lineage precursors are lymphoblast-like cells whose cytoplasm remains scant while receptor assembly and thymic selection proceed.
